note: George Derry the son, 18, is on the 1911 return for 10 Barrack Lane and has no record at all — the household holds his father, mother, two sisters and a niece but not him. His father is also George Derry, so this file matches on the birth year as well as the name: without that the son's census record would be hung on the father, who is #480. The transcription spells the family Denny for five of the six and Derry for the head; the record has them as Derry throughout, which A. Hagues confirms is right.

census.source: 1911 census, 10 Barrack Lane — transcribed by A. Hagues; recorded on the return as Denny

relationships.notes: Recorded as his son on the 1911 return for 10 Barrack Lane.
